effect_description_eng:
[Hand] [Main] If you have a Digimon or Tamer with the [CS] trait, by paying 5 cost, give 3 of your opponent's Digimon ＜Security A. -1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 fewer security card.) until their turn ends. Then, place this card as the top security card.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Return 1 of your opponent's Digimon with the lowest level to the hand.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] At the end of the battle, play this card without paying the cost. At turn end, delete this Digimon.
